description: Canonical 33-feature schema for static URL-based phishing detection.

url_length.description: Length of the normalized URL string.

hostname_length.description: Length of the lowercase IDNA-normalized ASCII hostname, excluding trailing root dot and IPv6 brackets.

domain_length.description: Length of the registrable domain label, excluding the public suffix.

path_length.description: Number of characters in the parsed URL path.

num_subdomains.description: Number of subdomain labels determined using the Public Suffix List.

subdomain_ratio.description: Number of subdomain labels divided by total hostname labels. Zero when registrable domain information is unavailable.

max_subdomain_length.description: Length of the longest subdomain label.

domain_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the lowercase IDNA ASCII registrable domain label.

domain_digit_count.description: Number of numeric digits in the registrable domain label.

domain_hyphen_count.description: Number of hyphens in the registrable domain label.

contains_unicode.description: 1 if the original hostname contains non-ASCII characters, otherwise 0.

non_ascii_count.description: Number of non-ASCII code points in the original hostname.

mixed_script.description: 1 if alphabetic characters in the hostname belong to more than one Unicode script, excluding Common, Inherited and Unknown scripts.

contains_punycode.description: 1 if any original hostname label starts with xn--, otherwise 0.

has_https.description: 1 if the URL scheme is HTTPS, otherwise 0.

has_ip_address.description: 1 if the hostname is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address, otherwise 0.

has_at_symbol_in_authority.description: 1 if the URL authority contains an @ symbol, otherwise 0.

has_double_slash_in_path.description: 1 if the parsed URL path contains consecutive forward slashes, otherwise 0.

has_encoded_characters.description: 1 if the URL contains at least one valid percent-encoded character (%HH), otherwise 0.

percent_encoded_count.description: Number of valid percent-encoded sequences (%HH) in the URL.

has_nonstandard_port.description: 1 if an explicitly specified port differs from the default port for its scheme, otherwise 0.

has_fragment.description: 1 if the URL contains a non-empty fragment, otherwise 0.

query_param_count.description: Number of parsed query parameters, including parameters with blank values.

query_length.description: Length of the raw parsed query string.

path_segment_count.description: Number of non-empty path segments, ignoring repeated and trailing slashes.

max_path_segment_length.description: Length of the longest non-empty raw path segment.

suspicious_keyword_subdomain_count.description: Number of configured suspicious keywords found in subdomain labels. Each keyword counts at most once per component.

suspicious_keyword_domain_count.description: Number of configured suspicious keywords found in the registrable domain label. Each keyword counts at most once.

suspicious_keyword_path_count.description: Number of configured suspicious keywords found in URL path segments. Each keyword counts at most once per component.

suspicious_keyword_query_count.description: Number of configured suspicious keywords found in query parameter names and values. Each keyword counts at most once.

tld_length.description: Length of the complete Public Suffix List suffix, excluding dots.

has_suspicious_tld.description: 1 if the complete public suffix matches the configured suspicious TLD list, otherwise 0.

has_url_shortener.description: 1 if the registrable domain matches a configured URL shortening service, otherwise 0.

suspicious_keywords.matching: Case-insensitive complete token matching. Tokens are separated by non-alphanumeric characters. Each keyword counts at most once per component.

suspicious_tlds.matching: Exact comparison against the complete PSL suffix.

url_shorteners.matching: Exact comparison against the registrable domain. No substring matching or redirect resolution.

label.name: label
label.description: Target class used for supervised machine learning.
label.note: The label is obtained from the dataset and is not generated by the feature extractor.
